action: In general, a standard system update will make all the necessary changes.
description:
Lukas Reschke discovered that the WebDAV support in Apache Jackrabbit
incorrectly checked the content type of requests when protecting against
cross-site request forgery. A remote attacker could possibly use this issue
to perform cross-site request forgery attacks.
isummary:
Apache Jackrabbit could allow a remote attacker to perform actions as
another user.
title: Apache Jackrabbit vulnerability
